items.title: Access granted: phishing with device code authorization for account takeover | Proofpoint US
items.excerpt: This report details how threat actors leverage device code authorization flows to execute account takeover attacks at scale. By directing users to counterfeit Microsoft 365 login portals, attackers capture the six-character device codes and exchange them for valid access tokens. The campaign highlights vulnerabilities in default cloud configurations and underscores the necessity of enforcing app consent policies, monitoring for anomalous OAuth grants, and deploying identity protection solutions.

items.title: CVE-2026-116163
items.excerpt: Parse Server before 8.6.102 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.5-alpha.2 contains an authentication bypass because the validateSetUp, validateLogin, and validateUpdate methods of custom adapters subclassing AuthAdapter are never called, and an inherited default that accepts any authData is used instead. Attackers can supply arbitrary authData to sign up, link identities, log in as existing users, or skip custom additional authentication factors.
